definitions.explanation: Describes something that doesn't work, is broken, or is of poor quality. Also used when efforts fail.
Used to express prohibition or that something shouldn't be done. Very direct way to say 'no' or 'you can't do that.'

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}って→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧だめ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: You're not allowed to take photos here.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧だめ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This computer is no good anymore.

examples.japanese: だめ！⟦{触|さわ}らないで→触る：00808_sawaru⟧！
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧だめ⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧だめ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}います→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: These shoes are worn out, so I'll buy new ones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：08388_nando⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧だめ⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: No matter how many times I tried, it didn't work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧だめ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧だめ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: You're not allowed to eat here.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅|おく}れたら→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧だめ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。

examples.english: We've been told that children are not allowed to go outside alone.

notes:
だめ is a na-adjective/noun meaning "no good" or "not allowed." Usually written in hiragana, though the kanji {駄目|だめ} exists.

KEY PATTERNS:
- 〜てはだめ: must not do (prohibition)
- 〜ちゃだめ: casual form of 〜てはだめ
- だめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go bad, to break down
- だめだった: it didn't work out

USAGE NOTES:
- Very direct; can sound harsh to children or in formal situations
- For polite prohibition, 〜ては⟦いけません→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧ is softer
- Xがだめ means "bad at X" or "can't handle X": ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧だめ (I'm not a morning person)

RELATED:
- ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧: impossible, unreasonable
- ⟦いけない→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧: not allowed (slightly softer)
